text:
jun: quick a11y note from an audit on the Alerts drawer. Two small issues: (1) focus gets trapped in the drawer when you open it via keyboard and press Escape — focus doesn't return to the original trigger, and (2) the severity pill contrast + the pill text in high-contrast mode is borderline.

jun: repro:
```
1) Console > Any page > open Alerts drawer (bell icon) with keyboard
2) Tab around, then press Esc to close
3) focus lands on body instead of bell button
```

lexi: saw this too. Also VoiceOver reads the drawer as "dialog" but doesn't announce the number of unread alerts. We should add aria-live or an aria-atomic update when counts change.

omar: modal focus restore is straightforward: capture trigger (event.target) before opening, on close call trigger.focus({preventScroll:true}). Also ensure drawer has aria-labelledby and role="dialog" and aria-modal=true.

sasha: for pills: current bg = #FFEDD5 and text #92400E on light mode; in HC the token flips and loses contrast. Propose stronger tokens: bg #F97316 with text #FFF or bg #FFEDD5 with text #7A2E00 depending on severity. I'll attach contrast checks.

jun: tiny copy nit: the dismiss button inside each alert only has an icon and aria-label="dismiss" which is too generic for SR. Make it "Dismiss alert: high CPU on inferencer-3" dynamically.

lexi: good call. Also make sure the small action buttons are reachable via keyboard (tabindex=0) and not only clickable. Some were anchor tags without role.

omar: tests: add a puppeteer e2e that opens the drawer, tabs a few items, presses Esc, and asserts document.activeElement is the bell button. Add an axe check for color-contrast on the pills.

sasha: I'll produce a small PR with token swaps and updated aria-labels. Low-risk — could go in 1.18.5 as an accessibility patch.

a11y-bot: reminder: include VoiceOver + NVDA manual QA steps in the issue checklist and note release notes entry under "Accessibility fixes".

jun: created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4710 with repro, screenshots, and suggested fixes. Pinging for reviews.

lexi: I'll QA VoiceOver after the staging canary. Thanks!
